name: Galia Barhava-Monteith
story: At a Women in Spatial breakfast reported in September 2015, Galia Barhava-Monteith of Professionelle spoke about barriers to career advancement, mentoring and informal professional networks. The group’s report records 47 attendees and presents her guidance as a career-development contribution, not as a survey of the spatial workforce.

sources.label: Women in Spatial, “What Stops Women Rising to the Top?”, 12 September 2015
